caption: The drawing features a single female figure standing upright on a plain, unadorned background. She has light skin, pink cheeks, and brown hair styled in soft waves framing her face. She is wearing a long, wide-sleeved dress that reaches just above her ankles. The dress is decorated with a pattern of fine gray and brown vertical and horizontal lines forming small squares. There are solid blue bands at the cuffs, the neckline, and near the bottom hem of the dress. Her feet are visible and bare, and her hands are slightly extended downward. The artist’s signature, "Alex Bush," appears in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Doll - "Emily"
